name: thin-entrypoint-contract-migration-plan
title: Define the host-neutral thin-entrypoint contract migration plan
description: Create an executable documentation-only plan for migrating Proof-or-stop root agent documents and their mechanical consumers from a Claude-first contract to host-neutral thin entrypoints, a canonical guide, a verified operational runbook, and normative decision sources. The plan must define sequencing, red/green tests, compatibility, rollback, implementation Story boundaries, and convergence for B-e514 without changing runtime behavior in this Story.
